documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported robust H1 FY26 financial performance, with revenues growing by 49.08% year-on-year to Rs. 78.77 crores and PAT increasing by 46.66% to Rs. 7.20 crores. Management highlighted diversified distribution across general trade, modern trade, and e-commerce, while expanding its portfolio into new categories like Soya Chunks and upcoming puja and devotional goods under the Neihaa Narayan brand. The company remains confident in sustaining growth momentum, operational efficiency, and maintaining healthy EBITDA margins in the second half of the fiscal year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the demand environment is encouraging and they are confident of sustaining growth momentum in the second half.
guidance.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the oil segment will be picked up very well in H2, making H2 better than H1.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that there is no competition at all in the pure groundnut oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: No, there is no competition at all in the groundnut oil segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the market size for spices is more than INR2 lakhs crores, with 70% currently in unorganized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 70% of atta is in loose, unorganized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, and festival items.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on 28 July 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of the 'Neihaa Narayan' puja devotional articles vertical.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the oil plant has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue for H1 FY26 stood at Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crore, and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue stood at Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crore and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven and not making losses.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they spend Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs monthly on media channels.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05%.
Profit margin for H1 FY26 stood at 9.14%.
Management stated that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming six months of depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum with current utilization at about 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with 12,650 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they will go for bank debt if needed.
capital_allocation.quote: If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on 10th October 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the entire amount raised from the rights issue was utilized for specified purposes without deviation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as disclosed in the letter of offer, we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geographical expansion into new states like Maharashtra presents a tough time and higher costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even we are expanding the geographical also, but as we launched in the Maharashtra, so we are having a very tough time in the Maharashtra. So, we are not getting that much of revenue speed, what we wanted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that growth targets were not reached last year due to challenges of the new setup and delay in the rights issue.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, as we have in the earlier this investor's meet we have committed some growth percentage and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, festival-related items, and allied products.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are planning to launch the new puja products in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to target export markets like the Middle East, Singapore, and the US in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that expansion plans for Atta and Spices will be considered within two years.
management_commitments.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects the Indian soy protein market to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
management_commitments.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated intentions to start exports in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: As of now, we cannot comment on that revenue part.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
